name: codex
question: One Codex round on one closed question (charter, section 7), read-only, through .cache/v04/tools/codex_affinity.ps1 (processors 8 to 31); the extra arguments are the wrapper's path and its -Prompt, -Answer, -Events and optional -Thread arguments.
choices: Reviewer traffic only (charter, step 0). The local process tree is metered in the job; the tokens are reported apart, by the real sum of the events. A data unit: the prompt file makes the unit.
